---
title: Build an agent app
description: A chat app in the framework you already use, backed by a Nyte host on your machine.
---

This page builds a chat page in the web framework you already use, with Nyte's agent answering
from your machine. The agent can read and change the project folder, so you can ask it about your
code or have it make changes.

The app runs as two processes:

- `server.ts` starts a host with `sdk.open`. The host signs in to the model, runs the agent and its
  tools, keeps the chats in `agent.db`, and serves all of it over HTTP.
- The page starts a chat with `sdk.connect`, attaches to the chat's rows with `openHost` and draws
  the answer as it streams in.

You need Node 26.4 or later and pnpm. The model is OpenAI's `openai-codex` provider, which signs in
with a ChatGPT Plus or Pro account.

## Build the chat [#build-the-chat]

<GroupPanel groupId="framework" value="Vite" defaultValue="Vite">

`server.ts` goes at the project root and runs the agent: the model login, the sessions and the tools. `src/App.tsx` replaces the template's app with the chat, and `src/api.ts` connects it to the host and opens the chat's head store, which holds the chat's rows and applies each change the host sends over a socket. `useSyncExternalStore` reads the chat, so React re-renders whenever the conversation changes or the answer streams.

```ts tab="server.ts"
import process from "node:process";
import { createInterface } from "node:readline/promises";
import { sqliteStore } from "@nyte-ai/host";
import { asId } from "@nyte-ai/schema";
import { sdk } from "@nyte-ai/sdk";
import type { Host } from "@nyte-ai/sdk";

const store = sqliteStore({ path: "./agent.db" });
const host = await sdk.open({ store });

// This chat can't answer approval requests, so tool calls run without asking.
await host.settings.apply("permissions", "full");

const { providers } = await host.models.list();

if (providers.find((provider) => provider.id === "openai-codex")?.credential === "missing") {
  await signIn(host);
}

const chosen = await host.models.setDefault({ provider: "openai-codex", id: "{{modelId}}" });

if (chosen.kind !== "set")
  throw new Error("Unknown model. Choose a provider and model id from host.models.list().");

const listener = await host.listen({
  // No port: the OS picks a free one, and the line below prints it.
  transport: { kind: "http" },
  auth: {
    kind: "custom",
    // Runs on every request and says who is calling. This one lets everyone in as the same user.
    authorize: () => ({
      // Principal ids are branded strings; asId turns "you" into one.
      principal: asId<"principal">("you"),
      // participant can start and use sessions. Owner calls, such as model sign-in, are refused.
      authority: new Set(["participant"]),
    }),
  },
  // The pages allowed to call the host: the address your dev server prints.
  origins: ["http://localhost:5173"],
});

console.log("Listening on", listener.address);

process.once("SIGINT", async () => {
  await host.close();
  await store.close();
});

async function signIn(host: Host) {
  const prompt = createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout });
  const login = host.models.login({ provider: "openai-codex", method: { kind: "oauth" } });

  for await (const step of login.steps()) {
    if (step.kind === "open") console.log("Sign in at", step.url, step.code ?? "");
    if (step.kind === "paste") await login.answer(await prompt.question(`${step.message} `));
    if (step.kind === "choose") {
      for (const option of step.options) console.log(`${option.id}: ${option.label}`);
      await login.answer(await prompt.question(`${step.message} `));
    }
    if (step.kind === "failed") throw new Error(step.reason);
  }

  prompt.close();
}
```

```tsx tab="src/App.tsx"
import { isPart, text } from "@nyte-ai/plugin/client";
import { useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import { startChat } from "./api";
import type { OpenChat } from "./api";

export default function App() {
  const [chat, setChat] = useState<OpenChat>();

  return chat ? (
    <Chat chat={chat} />
  ) : (
    <Composer onSend={async (content) => setChat(await startChat(content))} />
  );
}

function Chat({ chat }: { chat: OpenChat }) {
  const view = useSyncExternalStore(chat.subscribe, chat.snapshot);

  return (
    <main>
      {view?.messages.map((message) =>
        message.kind === "user" ? (
          <p key={message.id}>You: {typeof message.content === "string" ? message.content : ""}</p>
        ) : isPart(message, text) ? (
          <p key={message.id}>{message.state.markdown}</p>
        ) : null,
      )}
      <Composer onSend={(content) => chat.session.send(content)} />
    </main>
  );
}

function Composer({ onSend }: { onSend: (content: string) => Promise<unknown> }) {
  return (
    <form
      action={async (form) => {
        await onSend(String(form.get("content")));
      }}
    >
      <input name="content" aria-label="Message" required />
      <button>Send</button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```ts tab="src/api.ts"
import {
  headView,
  openHost,
  sdk,
  streamText,
  ticketSocket,
  withStreamedText,
} from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";
import type { HeadView, Live, Session, StreamedText } from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";

// The address `node server.ts` printed.
const url = "http://127.0.0.1:PORT";
// No headers: authorize in server.ts lets every request in.
const credentials = { kind: "custom", headers: () => ({}) } as const;

// The chat as a store: subscribe for changes, snapshot for the view to draw.
export interface OpenChat extends Live<HeadView | null> {
  readonly session: Session;
}

export async function startChat(content: string): Promise<OpenChat> {
  const connection = await sdk.connect({ url, credentials });
  const { session } = await connection.sessions.start({ content });

  // The host's rows over one socket. A page can't put headers on a WebSocket, so it trades them
  // for a ticket first.
  const live = openHost(url, {
    credentials,
    client: { kind: "app", name: "agent-chat", version: "1.0.0" },
    socket: ticketSocket(),
  });
  const store = live.head(session.id, session.name, { tail: 100 });
  const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  const notify = () => listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
  // The text parts are still streaming. A part's row gets its text only when the part settles.
  let texts: StreamedText = new Map();

  store.subscribe(notify);
  live.text((update) => {
    texts = streamText(texts, update);
    notify();
  });

  return {
    session,
    subscribe(listener) {
      listeners.add(listener);

      return () => listeners.delete(listener);
    },
    snapshot() {
      const snapshot = store.snapshot();

      return snapshot === null ? null : withStreamedText(headView(snapshot), texts);
    },
  };
}
```

```svelte tab="src/App.svelte"
<script lang="ts">
  import { isPart, text } from "@nyte-ai/plugin/client";
  import type { HeadView } from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";
  import { startChat } from "./api";
  import type { OpenChat } from "./api";

  let chat = $state<OpenChat>();
  let view = $state<HeadView>();
  let draft = $state("");

  $effect(() => {
    const open = chat;

    return open?.subscribe(() => {
      view = open.snapshot() ?? undefined;
    });
  });

  async function send(event: SubmitEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const content = draft;

    draft = "";
    if (chat) await chat.session.send(content);
    else chat = await startChat(content);
  }
</script>

<main>
  {#each view?.messages ?? [] as message (message.id)}
    {#if message.kind === "user"}
      <p>You: {typeof message.content === "string" ? message.content : ""}</p>
    {:else if isPart(message, text)}
      <p>{message.state.markdown}</p>
    {/if}
  {/each}
  <form onsubmit={send}>
    <input bind:value={draft} aria-label="Message" required />
    <button>Send</button>
  </form>
</main>
```

```vue tab="src/App.vue"
<script setup lang="ts">
import { isPart, text } from "@nyte-ai/plugin/client";
import type { HeadView } from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";
import { ref, shallowRef, watchEffect } from "vue";
import { startChat } from "./api";
import type { OpenChat } from "./api";

const chat = shallowRef<OpenChat>();
const view = shallowRef<HeadView>();
const draft = ref("");

watchEffect((onCleanup) => {
  const open = chat.value;

  if (open)
    onCleanup(
      open.subscribe(() => {
        view.value = open.snapshot() ?? undefined;
      }),
    );
});

async function send() {
  const content = draft.value;

  draft.value = "";
  if (chat.value) await chat.value.session.send(content);
  else chat.value = await startChat(content);
}
</script>

<template>
  <main>
    <template v-for="message in view?.messages ?? []" :key="message.id">
      <p v-if="message.kind === 'user'">
        You: {{ typeof message.content === "string" ? message.content : "" }}
      </p>
      <p v-else-if="isPart(message, text)">{{ message.state.markdown }}</p>
    </template>
    <form @submit.prevent="send">
      <input v-model="draft" aria-label="Message" required />
      <button>Send</button>
    </form>
  </main>
</template>
```

```ts tab="src/api.ts"
import {

  sdk,
  streamText,
  ticketSocket,
  withStreamedText,
} from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";
import type { HeadView, Live, Session, StreamedText } from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";

// The address `node server.ts` printed.
const url = "http://127.0.0.1:PORT";
// No headers: authorize in server.ts lets every request in.
const credentials = { kind: "custom", headers: () => ({}) } as const;

// The chat as a store: subscribe for changes, snapshot for the view to draw.
export interface OpenChat extends Live<HeadView | null> {
  readonly session: Session;
}

export async function startChat(content: string): Promise<OpenChat> {
  const connection = await sdk.connect({ url, credentials });
  const { session } = await connection.sessions.start({ content });

  // The host's rows over one socket. A page can't put headers on a WebSocket, so it trades them
  // for a ticket first.
  const live = openHost(url, {
    credentials,
    client: { kind: "app", name: "agent-chat", version: "1.0.0" },
    socket: ticketSocket(),
  });
  const store = live.head(session.id, session.name, { tail: 100 });
  const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
  const notify = () => listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
  // The text parts are still streaming. A part's row gets its text only when the part settles.
  let texts: StreamedText = new Map();

  store.subscribe(notify);
  live.text((update) => {
    texts = streamText(texts, update);
    notify();
  });

  return {
    session,
    subscribe(listener) {
      listeners.add(listener);

      return () => listeners.delete(listener);
    },
    snapshot() {
      const snapshot = store.snapshot();

      return snapshot === null ? null : withStreamedText(headView(snapshot), texts);
    },
  };
}
```

<GroupPanel groupId="framework" value="Nuxt" defaultValue="Vite">

`server.ts` goes at the project root and runs the agent: the model login, the sessions and the tools. `app/app.vue` replaces the starter's root component, and `app/api.ts` connects it to the host. Nuxt renders the page on the server first; the session starts only when you send, in the browser, and `app/api.ts` imports only `@nyte-ai/sdk/client`, so the server never loads the host.

```ts tab="server.ts"
import process from "node:process";
import { createInterface } from "node:readline/promises";
import { sqliteStore } from "@nyte-ai/host";
import { asId } from "@nyte-ai/schema";
import { sdk } from "@nyte-ai/sdk";
import type { Host } from "@nyte-ai/sdk";

const store = sqliteStore({ path: "./agent.db" });
const host = await sdk.open({ store });

// This chat can't answer approval requests, so tool calls run without asking.
await host.settings.apply("permissions", "full");

const { providers } = await host.models.list();

if (providers.find((provider) => provider.id === "openai-codex")?.credential === "missing") {
  await signIn(host);
}

const chosen = await host.models.setDefault({ provider: "openai-codex", id: "{{modelId}}" });

if (chosen.kind !== "set")
  throw new Error("Unknown model. Choose a provider and model id from host.models.list().");

const listener = await host.listen({
  // No port: the OS picks a free one, and the line below prints it.
  transport: { kind: "http" },
  auth: {
    kind: "custom",
    // Runs on every request and says who is calling. This one lets everyone in as the same user.
    authorize: () => ({
      // Principal ids are branded strings; asId turns "you" into one.
      principal: asId<"principal">("you"),
      // participant can start and use sessions. Owner calls, such as model sign-in, are refused.
      authority: new Set(["participant"]),
    }),
  },
  // The pages allowed to call the host: the address your dev server prints.
  origins: ["http://localhost:3000"],
});

console.log("Listening on", listener.address);

process.once("SIGINT", async () => {
  await host.close();
  await store.close();
});

async function signIn(host: Host) {
  const prompt = createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout });
  const login = host.models.login({ provider: "openai-codex", method: { kind: "oauth" } });

  for await (const step of login.steps()) {
    if (step.kind === "open") console.log("Sign in at", step.url, step.code ?? "");
    if (step.kind === "paste") await login.answer(await prompt.question(`${step.message} `));
    if (step.kind === "choose") {
      for (const option of step.options) console.log(`${option.id}: ${option.label}`);
      await login.answer(await prompt.question(`${step.message} `));
    }
    if (step.kind === "failed") throw new Error(step.reason);
  }

  prompt.close();
}
```

```vue tab="app/app.vue"
<script setup lang="ts">
import { isPart, text } from "@nyte-ai/plugin/client";
import type { HeadView } from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";
import { ref, shallowRef, watchEffect } from "vue";
import { startChat } from "./api";
import type { OpenChat } from "./api";

const chat = shallowRef<OpenChat>();
const view = shallowRef<HeadView>();
const draft = ref("");

watchEffect((onCleanup) => {
  const open = chat.value;

  if (open)
    onCleanup(
      open.subscribe(() => {
        view.value = open.snapshot() ?? undefined;
      }),
    );
});

async function send() {
  const content = draft.value;

  draft.value = "";
  if (chat.value) await chat.value.session.send(content);
  else chat.value = await startChat(content);
}
</script>

<template>
  <main>
    <template v-for="message in view?.messages ?? []" :key="message.id">
      <p v-if="message.kind === 'user'">
        You: {{ typeof message.content === "string" ? message.content : "" }}
      </p>
      <p v-else-if="isPart(message, text)">{{ message.state.markdown }}</p>
    </template>
    <form @submit.prevent="send">
      <input v-model="draft" aria-label="Message" required />
      <button>Send</button>
    </form>
  </main>
</template>
```

```tsx tab="src/App.tsx"
import { isPart, text } from "@nyte-ai/plugin/client";
import type { HeadView } from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";
import { createSignal, For, from, Show } from "solid-js";
import { startChat } from "./api";
import type { OpenChat } from "./api";

export default function App() {
  const [chat, setChat] = createSignal<OpenChat>();

  return (
    <Show
      when={chat()}
      fallback={<Composer onSend={async (content) => setChat(await startChat(content))} />}
    >
      {(open) => <Chat chat={open()} />}
    </Show>
  );
}

function Chat(props: { chat: OpenChat }) {
  const view = from<HeadView | undefined>((set) =>
    props.chat.subscribe(() => set(() => props.chat.snapshot() ?? undefined)),
  );

  return (
    <main>
      <For each={view()?.messages}>
        {(message) =>
          message.kind === "user" ? (
            <p>You: {typeof message.content === "string" ? message.content : ""}</p>
          ) : isPart(message, text) ? (
            <p>{message.state.markdown}</p>
          ) : null
        }
      </For>
      <Composer onSend={(content) => props.chat.session.send(content)} />
    </main>
  );
}

function Composer(props: { onSend: (content: string) => Promise<unknown> }) {
  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={async (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const form = event.currentTarget;
        const content = String(new FormData(form).get("content"));

        form.reset();
        await props.onSend(content);
      }}
    >
      <input name="content" aria-label="Message" required />
      <button>Send</button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

</GroupPanel>

In every framework, `startChat` returns the chat as a store of its own, with `subscribe` and
`snapshot`:

- `live.head` opens the head store. It reads the last 100 messages on the chat's head, then applies
  each change event the host sends. After a dropped socket, it resumes from the last seq it applied.
- A text part's row gets its text when the part settles. Until then, the text the model streams
  arrives on `live.text`, and `streamText` keeps it.
- `snapshot` builds the view from the rows with `headView`, and `withStreamedText` lays the streamed
  text over it. Both return the same view until something changes, which `useSyncExternalStore`
  needs.

## Run it [#run-it]

The host needs Node 26.4 or later:

```sh
node server.ts
```

The first run signs you in to your OpenAI account in the terminal. The login is saved in
`agent.db`, encrypted with the key in `~/.nyte/secret.key`, so later runs skip it. Copy the address
it prints into `api.ts`; the OS picks a new port each time the host starts.

```sh
pnpm dev
```

Open that address and send a message. The answer streams in as the host writes it. Before you put

This chat draws your messages and the text answers. Tool calls and other parts are skipped here;
[Render a session](/docs/sdk/guides/render-a-session#draw-the-messages) shows how to draw them.

## Or a terminal app [#terminal-app]

The same stores work outside a browser. There `openHost` puts the credential headers on the socket
itself, so it needs no `ticketSocket()`. This script asks the host one question and reprints the
latest answer each time it changes. Run it beside `server.ts`, with your question as the argument,
and press Ctrl+C when you're done:

```ts title="tui.ts"
import process from "node:process";
import { isPart, text } from "@nyte-ai/plugin/core";
import { headView, openHost, sdk, streamText, withStreamedText } from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";
import type { StreamedText } from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";

// The address `node server.ts` printed.
const url = "http://127.0.0.1:PORT";
const credentials = { kind: "custom", headers: () => ({}) } as const;
const connection = await sdk.connect({ url, credentials });
const live = openHost(url, {
  credentials,
  client: { kind: "other", name: "tui", version: "1.0.0" },
});
const { session } = await connection.sessions.start({ content: process.argv[2] ?? "Hello" });
const store = live.head(session.id, session.name, { tail: 20 });
let texts: StreamedText = new Map();

const show = () => {
  const snapshot = store.snapshot();

  if (snapshot === null) return;
  const view = withStreamedText(headView(snapshot), texts);
  const answer = view.messages.findLast((message) => isPart(message, text));

  if (answer === undefined || !isPart(answer, text)) return;
  console.clear();
  console.log(answer.state.markdown);
};

store.subscribe(show);

live.text((update) => {
  texts = streamText(texts, update);
  show();
});
```

```sh
node tui.ts "What does this project do?"
```

## The folder it works in [#the-folder-it-works-in]

The agent works in the folder you start the host from. It isn't a sandbox: its commands run as
you, with your files. Pass `workspace: { kind: "local", path }` to `sdk.open` to pick another
folder.

Context files (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`) load from the folder and its ancestors without trust;
start a session with `contextFiles: false` to skip them. The folder's extensions, such as
`.nyte/skills`, `.agents/skills` and `.nyte/plugins`, load only once you trust the folder:

```ts
const added = await host.workspaces.add({ kind: "local", path: process.cwd() });

if (added.kind === "added" || added.kind === "exists") {
  await host.workspace(added.workspace).update({ projectResources: true });
}
```

The decision is saved for the folder and the folders below it.

Tool calls run without approval by default. `host.settings.apply("permissions", "ask")` makes the
agent ask before commands and file changes. The `server.ts` above applies `"full"` because this
chat can't show approval requests; [Ask before tool calls](/docs/sdk/examples#ask-before-tool-calls)
shows how a client answers them.

## Before you deploy [#before-you-deploy]

- Replace `authorize` with your own sign-in. It receives each `Request`, so it can read your session
  cookie and return that user as the principal, or `{ deny: "unauthorized" }`.
- Serve the host over HTTPS, and list your site's exact origin in `origins`.
- To give each device its own revocable credential instead, use
  [pairing](/docs/sdk/guides/choose-an-entry-point#give-each-device-its-own-credential).

The host is a long-running process. A serverless function can't be one, because it stops when the
request ends; for serverless, start from the Vercel template below.

## Deploy it [#deploy-it]

| Template                                                                                              | What runs                                                       |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Cloudflare](https://github.com/interfaces-lab/nyte/blob/main/packages/examples/cloudflare/README.md) | One host in a SQLite-backed Durable Object, chat only           |
| [Vercel](https://github.com/interfaces-lab/nyte/blob/main/packages/examples/vercel/README.md)         | A Nitro app over PostgreSQL, with tools in a sandbox you supply |

## Extend it [#extend-it]

Plugins change what the agent can do and how clients draw it. A core plugin loads in the host and
adds tools, parts, skills, commands, settings and hooks. A client plugin loads in the app and adds
renderers, commands, settings and keybindings. Pass core plugins to `sdk.open({ plugins })`.

[Plugins](/docs/plugins) explains both kinds.
[Give the agent a tool](/docs/sdk/examples#give-the-agent-a-tool) is a complete core plugin in one
file.
